heroTitle: Insert Page Numbers into PDF Documents
heroDescription: Easily paginate your PDF files. Add customizable page numbers to headers or footers instantly for free.

sections.title: Free Pagination
sections.content: Add numbers to unlimited files without hitting paywalls.

sections.title: Secure Document Handling
sections.content: Your dissertations and reports are numbered privately on your machine.

sections.title: Batch Numbering
sections.content: Apply page numbers to massive documents in a fraction of a second.

faqs.q: Can I choose where the page numbers appear?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the position (e.g., bottom-right, top-center) and the margin size for perfect alignment.

faqs.q: Is it free for very large PDFs like textbooks?
faqs.a: Yes! Our tool can paginate a 1000-page textbook in milliseconds, completely free and without file size restrictions.

faqs.q: Will it alter my original document formatting?
faqs.a: No, the page numbers are cleanly overlaid onto the existing PDF structure without altering your original text or margins.
